basic.name: Take a Risk
basic.trigger: When you act despite a clear threat...
basic.text: ...say what you do and roll with the stat that best fits your approach.

outcomes.10+: It goes the way you wanted.
outcomes.7-9: It works, but the GM offers a worse outcome, a hard bargain, or an ugly choice.

basic.name: Brawl
basic.trigger: When you trade blows with something up close...

outcomes.10+: Deal your damage. Choose one: you also get clear of them, or you deal +1d4 and take their hit.
outcomes.7-9: Deal your damage and take their hit.
outcomes.6-: You are hit and gain nothing for it. Mark XP.

basic.name: Hold the Line
basic.trigger: When you stand guard over a place, a person, or a thing...

hold.name: Guard
hold.note: Spend 1 Guard to take a hit meant for someone else, halve a blow, or force an attacker to deal with you first.

outcomes.6-: Hold nothing; the GM says what slips past you. Mark XP.

basic.name: Recall Lore
basic.trigger: When you search your memory for something useful...

outcomes.10+: The GM tells you something true and useful.
outcomes.7-9: The GM tells you something true; making it useful is up to you.
outcomes.6-: You remember it wrong. Mark XP.

basic.name: Sway
basic.trigger: When you lean on someone who would rather not go along...

outcomes.10+: They go along with it, or tell you plainly what it would take.
outcomes.7-9: They name a price, and it is not a small one.
outcomes.6-: They dig in, and now they are watching you. Mark XP.

outcomes.10+: You claw your way back to 1 HP. Say what it cost you.
outcomes.7-9: You live, but you are out of the fight until someone tends to you.
outcomes.6-: This is the end, or something worse than an end. The GM will say.

special.name: Wrap Up
special.text: Mark XP for each: you acted on your instinct; a relationship shifted; the group learned something new about the world; the group made the village better.
